headline: ZESCO assures sufficient power supply
summary: ZESCO says the projected 2027 reduction in water allocation at Kariba Dam has been factored into its supply plans. The utility does not expect it to cause a national electricity deficit.
why: ZESCO is Zambia's state-owned electricity utility, and hydropower from Kariba is a major part of the country's generation. Water availability at the dam therefore affects power supply and the wider economy.
